verdict.rationale: Restate's AI material covers two other things, and neither is a built-in assistant a user can delegate tasks to. First, it gives developers primitives for building their own durable agents. Second, it offers a docs plugin and MCP integration that help external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) build Restate apps. Both are adjacent or external capabilities, so no direct support exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
